verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents granting read access on Shares to users or preset roles for tenant isolation, and an include pattern that limits which tables and views a Share exposes. Together these give role-based, table/view-level access control. There is no evidence of column-level permissions, row-level security, or masking policies, which are the core of the story's fine-grained governance ask. Missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level security policies, data masking policies, role management beyond read-only share grants, independent corroboration.
